_comment: Vehicles. clean_width = 0 means no cleaning head. storage = dust hopper capacity.

vehicles.name: Lunar Scooter
vehicles.desc: Zippy and quick. Your suit tank empties into its hopper when you hop in, so you can clean several tank-loads before selling.

vehicles.name: Utility Rover
vehicles.desc: Soft suspension and a huge hopper: your suit tank empties into it whenever you get in. Clean, hop in, repeat - then sell it all at once.

vehicles.name: Vacuum Buggy
vehicles.desc: Cleans a 4.5 metre strip as you drive. Toggle the vacuum with CLEAN.

vehicles.name: Industrial Cleaning Truck
vehicles.desc: A 14 metre wide cleaning boom on wheels. The Moon trembles.
